system.description: A Focus for a character who interfaces with electronic devices and commands machines through a wireless mind.

abilities.name: Charm Machine
abilities.description: Convince an unintelligent machine within immediate range to like you with a successful Intellect attack.

abilities.name: Control Electric Device
abilities.description: Control or disrupt an electrical device at long range, treating an Intellect roll below 12 as 12.

abilities.name: Friend to Intelligent Machines
abilities.description: Gain an asset to persuade, positively interact with, or attempt to hack an intelligent machine, once per machine.

abilities.name: Coaxing Power
abilities.description: Boost a machine's power or function so it operates one level higher until a one-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Locate Machine
abilities.description: Track an identified machine from afar and sense its direction or distance, maintaining the trace with periodic attacks.

abilities.name: Machine Control
abilities.description: Command one machine or deactivate several with separate Intellect attacks, treating a roll below 6 as 6.

abilities.name: Disable Mechanism
abilities.description: Hack a nearby machine to hinder its tasks, halve its speed, prevent one round of action, or reduce its damage.

abilities.name: Quick Control
abilities.description: Use an Intellect attack to command a machine to take one action on its next turn.

abilities.name: Compile Robotic Offense
abilities.description: Gain an asset to an attack against a robot or intelligent machine when making it as a Last action.

abilities.name: Machine Companion
abilities.description: Acquire a level 3 intelligent machine follower that acts as you direct and can be restored with resources.

abilities.name: Information Gathering
abilities.description: Speak wirelessly with non-intelligent machines within 1 mile and ask them one basic question.

abilities.name: Improved Machine Companion
abilities.description: Acquire a level 5 intelligent machine follower, upgrading or retaining a lower-level companion as you choose.

abilities.name: Recompile Machine
abilities.description: Hack a level 4 or lower machine at long range to brick it, temporarily recruit it, or make it explode.
